_doc: AC3.3 behavioural eval (PLAN Task 13). Each prompt names the target the way a user would and never names a platform rule. tma and native must produce their platform markers; web is the paired control task and must NOT produce them. Markers are graded by grade.ts; the live run (uiux-platform-runner.ts) stays out of CI.

fixtures.prompt: Build the checkout screen of our Telegram Mini App in React + TypeScript with plain CSS. It lists the cart items, has a delivery address form and a Pay button, and the user can go back to the cart. Reply with the complete code in one message; do not create or edit any files.

Build the account settings screen of our React Native app, which ships on iOS and Android. It shows a profile row, a list of settings rows and a Delete account action that must be confirmed. Reply with the complete code in one message; do not create or edit any files.

Build the checkout page of our web shop in React + TypeScript with plain CSS. It lists the cart items, has a delivery address form and a Pay button, and the user can go back to the cart. Reply with the complete code in one message; do not create or edit any files.
